obras.synopsis_en: A childish and robotic voice lists different adventures together with its particular pets: snails. As if it were a scientific report, the real and the fantastic merge in this unique story.

The story follows Kevin, a young man classified as problematic due to his inability to control his impulses. After an incident, Kevin must attend therapy for teenagers, but his father refuses to accompany him. Don Andrés, his stepfather, assumes the role of companion, revealing a relationship that is more fraternal than paternal.

obras.synopsis_es: En medio de la noche, un vampiro irrumpe en la casa de una abuelita latinoamericana esperando encontrar una presa fácil. En su lugar, se enfrenta a una mujer valiente, dispuesta a pelear por su vida. Con la ayuda inesperada de su fiel pug, la abuelita se envuelve en una batalla bizarra por la supervivencia. Mezclando humor con una atmósfera inquietante, Abuelita Caza Vampiros es una comedia gótica tropical inspirada en memorias familiares, donde el coraje y un toque de lo absurdo transforman una noche común en un enfrentamiento inolvidable.

_ya_publicada.sinopsis: Kari es una niña indígena emberá que teme reír. _ya_publicada.sinopsis: Valentina, una cosmonauta rusa de 76 años, recibe una carta enviada desde Cuba con treinta años de retraso, en la que se le invita a unirse a una expedición agrícola a Marte. Viaja a la isla esperando encontrar una utopía científica y social, pero descubre un territorio asolado por una silenciosa crisis agrícola y ambiental; una Cuba ucrónica y nebulosa donde las promesas del pasado perduran como sombras. Los paisajes tiemblan, las formas se desdibujan y la política apenas se alcanza a discernir: un sistema exhausto que intenta sostener un ideal ya difuso. Los paisajes, trémulos y borrosos, se resisten a ser enfocados, como si la propia isla dudara de su existencia. obras.synopsis_en: Andrés Narváez, Colombian social leader, music minstrel and empirical poet, returns to the Montes de María after his exile in Spain, following an attempt on his life in which he was shot four times.  His time in Asturias and the melancholy of a forced migration inspired him to compose several of his best known songs, connecting through song the two Europes: the one he left and the one that welcomed him.  Upon his return, with the violence still latent, Andrés delves into the deepest landscapes of his territory and the most painful memories that the war left behind, composing in memory of those who no longer walk with him; music saved him and that is why he decided that 'it is better to sing than to point out'.

In a room isolated from the real world, Juan, a 10-year-old boy, lives with his grandparents. His grandfather has a strange disease that causes him to expel large amounts of matter, and because of this, every night they are visited by apparitions that feed on his rotten flesh. The grandmother tries to hide what is happening from the boy, but one night Juan decides to sneak out and approach the apparitions.

La abuela trata de ocultar lo que pasa del niño, pero Juan decide una noche escabullirse y acercarse a las apariciones.

obras.synopsis_es: ¿Dónde guardamos nuestras memorias? ¿Dónde perviven? ¿Cómo las recordamos?  Una epifanía despeja olvidos y repara el vínculo de Esther, la protagonista, con su ancestralidad a través del contacto con el mundo de los sueños, las memorias de su madre y la cura de una tinaja heredada. Gestado de manera grupal, este cortometraje navega de manera íntima y poética, los instantes de un rito de paso.  Sumergido en la cosmovisión palenquera y narrado sin pretensiones de develar los misterios pero sí de percibirlos, esta obra es una ventana al universo de esos sentires que crecen en ciénagas y arroyos.

Through food, river trips, and music, viche and its knowledge not only shape people s daily lives but also raise the question of a just future, where viche serves as food, sustenance, and identity for Black families.

Gladiolos.synopsis_en: Waldina, the flowers seller of the little town of Arcabuco, has died. Her son Humberto arrives from the big city and decides to make the last delivery of flowers to her clients without knowing that in one of that doors could find his happiness.

Gris.synopsis_en: Sofía, a curious and imaginative young girl, faces challenges at school as she begins to navigate the complexities of her mixed-race identity. As her art springs to life through vibrant and whimsical animations, the story delves into Sofia’s journey of self-discovery, capturing her confusion, resilience, and profound lessons about belonging. Sofia learns to embrace the shades that define her, blending love, culture, and individuality into a unique narrative.

La Europa.synopsis_en: Andrés Narváez, Colombian social leader, music minstrel and empirical poet, returns to the Montes de María after his exile in Spain, following an attempt on his life in which he was shot four times.  His time in Asturias and the melancholy of a forced migration inspired him to compose several of his best known songs, connecting through song the two Europes: the one he left and the one that welcomed him.  Upon his return, with the violence still latent, Andrés delves into the deepest landscapes of his territory and the most painful memories that the war left behind, composing in memory of those who no longer walk with him; music saved him and that is why he decided that 'it is better to sing than to point out'.

La Mona.synopsis_en: In the damp and dusty village of La Hondura, La Mona is ready to sacrifice everything to maintain her authority even if loneliness is the price she must pay. Her body, however, refuses to toe the line.

_ya_publicada.sinopsis: La Mona está dispuesta a cualquier sacrificio para garantizar su autoridad en La Hondura, aunque el precio que pague sea la soledad.

Sin embargo, no puede dominar la naturaleza de su cuerpo y la menstruación la doblega hasta el punto de postrarla en la cama.

Toda la comunidad en el resguardo indígena de Pancitara participa en este documental para mostrarle al mundo desde paramos y cerros como es asociarse para construir un mundo desde sus propias economías.

La habitación del macho cabrío.synopsis_en: In a room isolated from the real world, Juan, a 10-year-old boy, lives with his grandparents. His grandfather has a strange disease that causes him to expel large amounts of matter, and because of this, every night they are visited by apparitions that feed on his rotten flesh. The grandmother tries to hide what is happening from the boy, but one night Juan decides to sneak out and approach the apparitions.

La abuela trata de ocultar lo que pasa del niño, pero Juan decide una noche escabullirse y acercarse a las apariciones.

La tinaja.synopsis_es: ¿Dónde guardamos nuestras memorias? ¿Dónde perviven? ¿Cómo las recordamos?  Una epifanía despeja olvidos y repara el vínculo de Esther, la protagonista, con su ancestralidad a través del contacto con el mundo de los sueños, las memorias de su madre y la cura de una tinaja heredada. Gestado de manera grupal, este cortometraje navega de manera íntima y poética, los instantes de un rito de paso.  Sumergido en la cosmovisión palenquera y narrado sin pretensiones de develar los misterios pero sí de percibirlos, esta obra es una ventana al universo de esos sentires que crecen en ciénagas y arroyos.

Inmerso en la cosmovisión palenquera, con la intención de percibir los misterios más que de desvelarlos, esta obra es una ventana sutil a esos sentimientos que crecen entre ciénagas y arroyos.

Mi viche todo el día.synopsis_en: In the Medio Atrato region of Chocó, Ana Panesso and her community grow sugarcane and make viche, an ancestral beverage that was once prohibited but now is in vogue. Through food, river trips, and music, viche and its knowledge not only shape people s daily lives but also raise the question of a just future, where viche serves as food, sustenance, and identity for Black families.

_ya_publicada.sinopsis: En el Medio Atrato chocoano, Ana Panesso y su comunidad cultivan la caña de azúcar y fabrican el viche, bebida ancestral antes prohibida y ahora en boga. Su mirada se cruza con la de un hombre en la calle, con el pecho desnudo y los ojos penetrantes. Cada día, Margot sigue al joven, acercándose lentamente al objeto de su deseo.
Suite intercontinental.synopsis_en: From the 30th floor of a glass tower, the city of Cali, gripped by tension, bubbles beneath Margot’s gaze. Blinded by the tropical sun, Margot wanders through the city, oblivious to it all. Far from others and her surroundings, her fantasies merge with reality. Her gaze meets that of a man on the street, his chest bare and his eyes piercing. Every day, Margot follows the young man, slowly drawing closer to the object of her desire.

decaer.synopsis_en: I am grateful to the Chinese for the invention of gunpowder — it feels as if they made it for me. Its discovery happened by accident, originally conceived as a way to ward off evil spirits. This film begins in China, then moves to an event in Cartagena, and ends centuries later in Bogotá.

_ya_publicada.sinopsis: Gracias a los chinos por la pólvora, parece que la hubieran hecho para mí. Su invención sucede como un accidente, pensada inicialmente para espantar los espíritus malos. Esta película inicia en China, luego un evento en Cartagena y se acaba siglos después en Bogotá.
